```{r}
library(tsibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(GGally)
library(ipeadatar)
library(corrplot)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(fable)
library(feasts)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(countrycode)
library(ggrepel)
library(fable.prophet)
theme_set(theme_bw())
```

```{r}
co2 <- read.csv("co2-fossil-plus-land-use.csv", header = T)

head(co2)
```

```{r}
co2 <- co2 |>
  rename(
    CO2total = Annual.CO..emissions.including.land.use.change,
    CO2landuse = Annual.CO..emissions.from.land.use.change,
    CO2fossilfuels = Annual.CO..emissions
  )
```

```{r}
co2 <- co2 |>
  # remove entradas com (GCP)
  filter(!str_detect(Entity, "\\(GCP\\)")) |>
  # remove agregações globais e regionais
  filter(!Entity %in% c("World",
                        "Africa", "Asia", "Europe", "North America",
                        "South America", "Oceania",
                        "European Union (27)", "European Union (28)",
                        "High-income countries", "Low-income countries",
                        "Lower-middle-income countries",
                        "Upper-middle-income countries",
                        "International aviation", "International shipping",
                        "Non-OECD", "OECD")) |>
  # remove agregações regionais tipo "Asia (excl. China and India)"
  filter(!str_detect(Entity, "excl")) |>
  arrange(Entity)
```

```{r}
co2 <- co2 |>
  mutate(Continent = countrycode(Entity, origin = "country.name", destination = "continent"))
```

```{r}
co2 <- co2 |>
  mutate(Continent = countrycode(Entity, origin = "country.name", destination = "continent"),
         Continent = case_when(
           Entity == "Kosovo" ~ "Europe",
           Entity == "Micronesia (country)" ~ "Oceania",
           TRUE ~ Continent
         ))
```

```{r}
co2 |>
  filter(Entity == "Vatican")
```

```{r}
co2 |>
  group_by(Continent, Entity) |>
  summarise(Total_CO2 = sum(CO2total, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop_last") |>
  mutate(share = Total_CO2 / sum(Total_CO2) * 100)
```

```{r}
valid_countries <- co2 |>
  filter(Year == 2023) |>
  drop_na(CO2total, CO2landuse, CO2fossilfuels) |>
  pull(Entity) |>
  unique()

co2 <- co2 |>
  filter(Entity %in% valid_countries)
```

```{r}
base_2023 <- co2 |>
  filter(Year == 2023)

shares_2023 <- base_2023 |>
  # group_by(Continent) |>
  mutate(share = CO2total / sum(CO2total, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup()

outros_paises <- shares_2023 |>
  filter(share <= 0.01) |>
  pull(Entity)

co2_grouped <- co2 |>
  mutate(Entity = ifelse(Entity %in% outros_paises,
                         "Others (<1%)", Entity)) |>
  group_by(Continent, Entity, Year) |>
  summarise(
    CO2total = sum(CO2total, na.rm = TRUE),
    CO2landuse = sum(CO2landuse, na.rm = TRUE),
    CO2fossilfuels = sum(CO2fossilfuels, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

co2_grouped |>
  filter(Entity == "Others (<1%)", Year == 2023)
```

```{r}
co2_grouped |>
  # filter(Continent == "Asia") |>
  filter(Year == 2023) |>
  arrange(Continent, Year, desc(CO2total))
```

```{r}
co2_ts <- co2_grouped |>
  pivot_longer(cols = CO2total:CO2fossilfuels,
               names_to = "Type",
               values_to = "Value") |>
  mutate(Year = year(as.Date(paste0(Year, "-01-01")))) |>
  relocate(Year) |>
  as_tsibble(index = Year, key = c(Continent, Entity, Type)) |>
  rename(Country = Entity)
```

```{r}
co2_ts |>
  filter(Type != "CO2total") |>
  filter(Continent != "Antarctica") |>
  filter_index("1900"~.) |>
  group_by(Continent, Type) |>
  summarise(Value = sum(Value)) |>
  autoplot(Value, aes(color = Type, lty = Type), size = .7) +
  facet_wrap(~ Continent, 
             # scales = "free_y", 
             nrow=1) + 
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = ""),
         lty = guide_legend(title = "")) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(y = "CO2 (ton)")
```

```{r}
co2_ts |>
  filter(Type != "CO2total") |>
  filter(Continent != "Antarctica") |>
  filter_index("1900"~.) |>
  autoplot(Value, aes(color = Type)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(Continent,Country), scales = "free_y")
```

```{r}
co2_ts |>
  filter(Type == "CO2total") |>
  filter_index("1900"~.) |>
  filter(Continent != "Antarctica") |>
  group_by(Continent) |>
  autoplot(Value, aes(color = Country), size = .7) +
  facet_wrap(~Continent, scales = "free_y") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = ""),
         lty = guide_legend(title = "")) +
  # theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(y = "CO2 (ton)")
```

```{r}
labels <- co2_ts |>
  filter(Type == "CO2total", Continent != "Antarctica") |>
  group_by(Continent, Country) |>
  filter(Year == max(Year)) |>
  ungroup()

co2_ts |>
  filter_index("1900"~.) |>
  filter(Type == "CO2total", Continent != "Antarctica") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = Value, color = Country)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = labels,
    aes(label = Country),
    hjust = 0,               
    nudge_x = 3,             
    size = 3,
    segment.color = NA,     
    direction = "y"        
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Continent, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +      
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")           
```

```{r}
co2_hts <- co2_ts |> 
  filter(Type != "CO2total") |> 
  filter_index("1900"~.) |>
  aggregate_key((Continent/Country) * Type, Value = sum(Value))
```

```{r}
path <- "Resultados_RFO_EM&S"
if(!dir.exists(path)) dir.create(path)
```

```{r}
library(future)
plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores() - 1)  # model() paraleliza sozinho via future

w     <- 12   # nº de origens por horizonte
h_max <- 6

all_dates <- sort(unique(co2_hts$Year))
N    <- length(all_dates)
init <- N - w - h_max + 1   # 1ª origem = mesmo i inicial do loop para h = 6

# Janelas expansíveis: .id = 1 tem 'init' anos, .id = 2 tem init+1, ...
co2_cv <- co2_hts |>
  fill_gaps() |>
  stretch_tsibble(.init = init, .step = 1) |>
  filter(.id <= N - init)   # descarta a última janela (série completa, sem ano de teste)

fit_cv <- co2_cv |>
  model(arima   = ARIMA(Value),
        ets     = ETS(Value),
        nnetar  = NNETAR(Value),
        prophet = prophet(Value)) |>
  reconcile(
    bu_a = bottom_up(arima),   ols_a = min_trace(arima, method = "ols"),
    mint_a = min_trace(arima, method = "mint_shrink"),
    wlsv_a = min_trace(arima, method = "wls_var"),
    wlss_a = min_trace(arima, method = "wls_struct"),
    bu_e = bottom_up(ets),     ols_e = min_trace(ets, method = "ols"),
    mint_e = min_trace(ets, method = "mint_shrink"),
    wlsv_e = min_trace(ets, method = "wls_var"),
    wlss_e = min_trace(ets, method = "wls_struct"),
    bu_n = bottom_up(nnetar),  ols_n = min_trace(nnetar, method = "ols"),
    mint_n = min_trace(nnetar, method = "mint_shrink"),
    wlsv_n = min_trace(nnetar, method = "wls_var"),
    wlss_n = min_trace(nnetar, method = "wls_struct"),
    bu_p = bottom_up(prophet), ols_p = min_trace(prophet, method = "ols"),
    mint_p = min_trace(prophet, method = "mint_shrink"),
    wlsv_p = min_trace(prophet, method = "wls_var"),
    wlss_p = min_trace(prophet, method = "wls_struct")
  )

plan(sequential)   # forecast em paralelo estoura a memória (fit_cv ~1,8 GB por worker)

fc_cv <- fit_cv |>
  forecast(h = h_max, times = 200) |>   # times menor acelera bastante o NNETAR
  group_by_key() |>
  mutate(h = row_number()) |>            # horizonte 1..6 dentro de cada origem
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(origem = init + .id - 1) |>     # equivale ao 'i' do loop antigo
  filter(origem >= N - w - h + 1,        # mesmas 12 origens por h do loop
         origem <= N - h)                # (também elimina anos sem observação)

# Guarda as previsões para não precisar reajustar os modelos, e libera memória
saveRDS(fc_cv, file.path(path, "fc_cv.rds"))
rm(fit_cv); gc()
```

```{r}
# Erros por série × origem × horizonte, com o nível hierárquico (6 níveis exclusivos)
obs <- co2_hts |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(Year, Country, Continent, Type, obs = Value)

erros <- fc_cv |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(.model, .id, h, Year, Country, Continent, Type, .mean) |>
  left_join(obs, by = c("Year", "Country", "Continent", "Type")) |>
  mutate(
    ae = abs(obs - .mean),
    nivel = case_when(
      is_aggregated(Continent) & is_aggregated(Type)  ~ "1 Total",
      is_aggregated(Continent) & !is_aggregated(Type) ~ "2 Type",
      is_aggregated(Country)   & is_aggregated(Type)  ~ "3 Continent",
      is_aggregated(Country)   & !is_aggregated(Type) ~ "4 Continent x Type",
      is_aggregated(Type)                             ~ "5 Country",
      TRUE                                            ~ "6 Country x Type"
    ),
    across(c(Country, Continent, Type), as.character)
  ) |>
  select(.model, .id, h, nivel, Continent, Country, Type, obs, ae)

saveRDS(erros, file.path(path, "erros_cv.rds"))
```
